summary: OSpec 1.8.13 fixes the secondary continuation failures exposed by three resumed real Goals: prerequisite reviews now run before retryable dependent work, declared cross-task repair scopes carry frozen owner provenance and fresh owner reviews, and bounded controller polling keeps claimed long-running children leased without weakening absolute deadlines. Worker packets also flag unscoped full Docker rebuilds before they pull unrelated optional runtimes.
new: Added complete cross-task repair scope snapshots and declared owner IDs to task retry provenance.
Added controllerObservedAt lease evidence for bounded supervision polls.
Added worker packet warnings for unscoped full Docker Compose rebuilds.
improved: Schedules missing prerequisite task reviews before retryable dependent worker attempts.
Lets a valid finding repair both its current task and paths owned by completed tasks, then independently re-reviews changed owners.
Keeps a claimed long-running child alive while the controller continues bounded polling, without extending the fixed absolute action deadline.
fixed: Fixed retryable blocked work throwing before the scheduler reached its prerequisite-review branch.
Fixed valid cross-task findings having no safe route through a validator or shared artifact owned by an earlier completed task.
Fixed supervised long verification attempts expiring only because separate heartbeat calls were missed during repeated controller polls.
docs: Documented the Web prerequisite-review incident, Mobile multi-owner repair contract, AIHub Docker scope failure, lease renewal behavior, and unchanged safety gates.
